hypothesis: An oversold exposure episode should expire after the existing 40-bar signal lookback; prolonged non-reverting episodes caused concentrated losses.

policy.exit_decision: at the close after 40 active target bars; execute at next open
policy.entry_rearm: after expiry remain flat until original mean-reversion target resets to zero; no immediate reentry while same oversold episode persists
policy.entry_parameters: unchanged lookback 40 / entry z -2 / exit z 0
policy.costs_and_latency: all four preregistered baseline profiles unchanged
policy.warm_start: same start/account rules as baseline; episode age follows known history

evaluation.cohorts: all six baseline cohorts; all are already seen
evaluation.classification: exploratory paired diagnostic, not pristine OOS, not prospective
